title: Microsoft AI SKILLS FEST June 8 – 12, 2026​: Even a free certification exam (Covers two Business Central Certifications)
summary: Microsoft AI Skills Fest (June 8-12, 2026) offers free certification exams and training, including two Business Central certifications: Developer Associate and Functional Consultant Associate. Registration is open and participants can earn badges, achievements, and exclusive prizes.
key_points: Free certification exams available for Business Central Developer Associate and Functional Consultant Associate
Event runs June 8-12, 2026 with registration open
Participants can earn badges, achievements, and exclusive prizes
Multiple learning tracks curated by role with self-paced exploration

quotes.text: Unlock achievements, badges, exclusive prizes, and even a free certification exam.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the main incentives for participating in the AI Skills Fest event
